scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @botbond/contracts && npm run build --workspace @botbond/observability && npm run build --workspace @botbond/gateway && npm run build --workspace botbond-web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @botbond/contracts && npm run build --workspace @botbond/observability && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @botbond/contracts && npm run build --workspace @botbond/observability && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.e2e: npm run build --workspace @botbond/contracts && npm run build --workspace @botbond/observability && npm run e2e --workspace @botbond/gateway
scripts.test:firestore: JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21 PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project botbond-test "npm run test --workspace @botbond/gateway -- --run test/firestore-repository.test.ts"
scripts.test:role-c: npm exec --package typescript@5.9.3 ts-mocha -- -p tsconfig.json -t 1000000 tests/**/*.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:firestore && npm run build && npm run e2e
